title: `error_if` sometimes raises `ValueError` instead of `EquinoxRuntimeError` depending on execution order
author: bonauer-pf

comments.author: patrick-kidger
comments.body:
Thanks for the report! This should be fixed in https://github.com/patrick-kidger/equinox/pull/1157. Looks like JAX will sometimes emit a `ValueError` and will sometimes emit a `JaxRuntimeError`.

I seem to recal that this discrepancy could also occur in very old versions of JAX.

comments.author: bonauer-pf
comments.body: Incredible, thanks for the super fast response! I've also reported the upstream issue to JAX here: https://github.com/jax-ml/jax/issues/34083
